verdict.rationale: The creating-llamafiles docs say a llamafile can bundle the executable, model weights and a set of default arguments into one self-contained file. That gives power-users a first-party way to package a task-specific configured model, but the evidence never shows persona, system-prompt or task-specific assistant configuration. Missing for 10: documented system-prompt/persona configuration, any assistant-builder or preset management, examples of task-specialized assistants, and hands-on corroboration.
